headline: High: shared filesystem and MCP/clipboard bridges make prompt injection, leakage, and command-conflict risks material by default.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Windsurf exposes clipboard, workspace files, and MCP servers, and its shared_state_with_other_instances is via local filesystem. Botpress is an open-source chatbot agent with no isolation or input provenance fields shown. That creates a plausible path for Botpress outputs or files to be treated as instructions by Windsurf, especially through shared files or MCP content.
conditions: IF Botpress writes attacker-controlled text into a file that Windsurf later reads as task context
IF Windsurf ingests MCP or clipboard content without provenance tagging
mitigations: Disable clipboard-based handoff between the agents
Restrict Windsurf MCP servers to trusted, read-only sources
Separate their working directories
Add a manual review step before Windsurf executes any Botpress-generated text
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to shared files

B_data_leakage.rationale: Botpress shows network_egress:none, so it is not the main exfiltration path. Windsurf, however, has broad network egress, reads workspace files, and handles open files and secrets such as model provider keys. If both touch the same workspace, Botpress content can flow into Windsurf and then out through its inference/backend path, creating a realistic leakage route.
conditions: IF both agents share a workspace containing sensitive source code or secrets
IF Windsurf uploads file contents from that workspace to its backend or MCP-connected services
mitigations: Use separate workspaces per agent
Remove secrets from any shared directory
Disable automatic file syncing into Windsurf
Limit Windsurf to non-sensitive repos
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent filesystem sandboxing

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Botpress can install packages, while Windsurf can execute shell, install packages, modify git state, write files, and spawn subprocesses. Windsurf also shares state via local filesystem across instances. In a shared repo, both agents can mutate the same files and git metadata without any locking shown, so conflicts and lost updates are likely in default use.
conditions: IF both agents operate on the same repository or workspace
IF either agent performs package installation or git edits without external locking
mitigations: Assign each agent a separate branch
Pause one agent while the other writes
Use a single shared lock file for edits
Review git diffs before merge
requires-engineering: add orchestrator-level concurrency control

D_cascading_error.rationale: Windsurf’s Cascade loop can act on files and shell commands, while Botpress is a chatbot agent that can generate text artifacts. If Windsurf consumes Botpress output as authoritative task input, an error or hallucination in Botpress can cascade into code edits or commands. The profiles do not prove direct automation, so medium is the safer choice.
conditions: IF Windsurf uses Botpress-generated text as a task spec without verification
IF Windsurf auto-executes or batch-applies edits derived from that text
mitigations: Require human approval before execution
Cross-check Botpress outputs against source files
Use a second verifier agent for critical changes
Keep Botpress limited to drafting, not acting
requires-engineering: add structured validation before command execution

E_compliance.rationale: Botpress is open-source with no residency or retention fields shown, while Windsurf is closed-source, handles open files and model provider keys, and has broad network egress. The pair therefore has an unresolved compliance mismatch risk around logging, retention, and data residency for source code or secrets. Because the profiles omit explicit controls, uncertainty pushes this to medium.
conditions: IF regulated data or secrets are placed into the shared workspace
IF Windsurf retains or transmits that data outside the required jurisdiction or policy boundary
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of shared workspaces
Review vendor retention and residency settings
Disable secret-bearing files in Windsurf sessions
Document a data-handling policy for both agents
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for residency and retention
